nodes.description: Privileged owner address of UniswapExchange; set from msg.sender in constructor and gates privileged functions.
Public mapping tracking token balances; mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances; decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Whitelisted trade address bypassing sale conditions in ensure; set by setTradeAddress.
Public total token supply, initialized in constructor from _supply.
Mapping of addresses allowed to sell; consulted as whitelist bypass in ensure.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition.
Maximum number of sales per address; configured in init and read in condition.
Minimum sale amount; configured in init and enforced in condition.
Maximum sale amount; configured in init and enforced in condition.
Constant 18 decimals used for supply scaling in init and constructor.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transfer logic using unchecked allowance/balance mutations and ensure checks.
Internal whitelist check: bypasses condition for owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses.
Public payable function writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-value safety net.
Internal view enforcing sale count and min/max sale bounds used by ensure.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only initializer for sale parameters scaled by decimals; returns without explicit bool value.
Owner-only loop distributing tokens; multiplies _value by _tos.length without SafeMath.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Payable constructor assigning owner, supply, balances and an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
Internal pure helper computing a Uniswap pair address via keccak256 of packed factory/token data.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, allowances and balance mutations.
Low-level delegatecall to attacker-influenced address inside delegate, executing arbitrary code in this contract's context.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom (pre-0.8, no SafeMath).
Unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value in batchSend loop (pre-0.8, no SafeMath).
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom (pre-0.8, no SafeMath).

edges.reason: constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting caller-derived privileges.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the source of transferFrom.
transfer delegates all work to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
msg.sender indexes allowance and is checked against _from in transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
init is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before moving balances.
transferFrom reads and mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value occurs inside transferFrom.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value occurs inside transferFrom.
ensure computes the pair via pairFor for whitelist comparison.
ensure falls back to require(condition(_from,_value)).
ensure whitelists transfers when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure whitelists transfers when _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure whitelists transfers when canSale[_from] is true.
condition reads _saleNum to bound sales per address.
condition compares _minSale against _value.
condition compares _value against _maxSale.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
delegate performs a delegatecall into attacker-influenced target, allowing arbitrary external code execution in this context.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing delegatecall.
init writes _minSale from the token argument.
init writes _maxSale from the maxToken argument.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum argument.
init scales sale bounds using decimals.
batchSend reads and mutates balanceOf for msg.sender and each recipient.
Unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value occurs inside the batchSend loop.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
constructor sets owner from the deployer.
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full supply.
constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_from parameter supplies the debited address in transferFrom.
_to parameter supplies the credited address in transferFrom.
_value parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom.
_to parameter is forwarded to transferFrom by transfer.
_value parameter is forwarded to transferFrom by transfer.
_tos array supplies the recipients iterated in batchSend.
_value is the per-recipient amount and multiplication factor in batchSend.
parameter a is the delegatecall target inside delegate.
parameter b is the delegatecall payload inside delegate.
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum by init.
token parameter is scaled into _minSale by init.
maxToken parameter is scaled into _maxSale by init.
addr parameter is stored into the tradeAddress whitelist.
_name parameter initializes token name.
_symbol parameter initializes token symbol.
_supply parameter initializes totalSupply.
_spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
_value parameter is the allowance amount set in approve.
_from parameter is compared against whitelisted addresses in ensure.
_to parameter is compared against owner in ensure.
_value parameter is passed to condition by ensure.
_from parameter indexes _onSaleNum in condition.
_value parameter is compared to _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
Local _UNI pair address is used as a whitelist bypass condition in ensure.
Local total accumulates _value * _tos.length without SafeMath in batchSend.
Loop-local _to receives unchecked balance increments in batchSend.
Loop counter i drives the batchSend distribution loop.

normalization_plan.reason: transferFrom._from is only consumed by transferFrom, so it collapses into that core function.
transferFrom._to is only consumed by transferFrom, so it collapses into that core function.
transferFrom._value drives the unchecked balance and allowance mutations in transferFrom.
transfer._to is forwarded directly into transferFrom from transfer.
transfer._value is forwarded directly into transferFrom from transfer.
batchSend._tos supplies the loop recipients of batchSend.
batchSend._value feeds the unchecked total and balance increments of batchSend.
delegate.a is the target of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
delegate.b is the calldata of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
init.saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init.
init.token is scaled into _minSale by init.
init.maxToken is scaled into _maxSale by init.
setTradeAddress.addr is written into the tradeAddress whitelist.
constructor._name initializes the token name in the constructor.
constructor._symbol initializes the token symbol in the constructor.
constructor._supply initializes totalSupply in the constructor.
approve._spender indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
approve._value is the allowance amount written by approve.
ensure._from participates in the whitelist bypass checks of ensure.
ensure._to participates in the owner bypass check of ensure.
ensure._value is forwarded into condition by ensure.
condition._from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition.
condition._value is compared against the sale bounds in condition.
Local _UNI is computed and consumed solely inside ensure.
Local total is computed and consumed solely inside batchSend.
Loop-local _to is used solely inside the batchSend loop.
Loop counter i is used solely inside the batchSend loop.
